title: tabernaemontana siphilitica
intro: Tabernaemontana siphilitica, commonly known as Yellow Ipecac or Yellow Ipecacuanha, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana siphilitica include analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities, making the plant a valuable resource for the development of new therapeutic agents.
